verification.note: ToolbarMenu.tsx:149 declares `valueClassName?: string`, :169 destructures it, and :241-253 builds the value span's className with `[...].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || undefined`. Grep for valueClassName under frontend/ finds it only in ToolbarMenu.tsx and at PdfPreview.tsx:611. docs/process/reviews/fix-pdf-toolbar-narrow/ has decisions.md, r1/ and r5-shots/ but no invariants.md. The class composition keeps the earlier behaviour: with valueClassName undefined, the output equals the old ternary (`undefined` when neither showLabel nor truncateValue is set).

PdfPreview.tsx:564 puts `@container w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-bg-card` on the data-viewer-frame root that wraps the toolbar and the page canvas. In PdfPreview.tsx, Grep for `@container|@max-` matches only :564 and :611. FilePreview.tsx:214 renders PdfPreview. globals.css:1519-1521 sets only `border-radius: 0` on `[data-viewer-frame]`. The frame is w-full, so inline-size containment is unlikely to change its width in practice. I did not check this in a browser.

PdfPreview.tsx:611 holds `@max-[38rem]:-ml-1.5`. pdf-toolbar-row-desktop.spec.ts measures only the following: the row count from the vertical middles of the bar's children (:53-66, :115-119), whether the value span's width is greater than 1px (:64, :122), the bar height (:123), and the aria-label (:82-86). Nothing reads the svg icon's position or the button's padding symmetry. Grep finds no `ml-1.5` or `@max` in any spec or test file. decisions.md:9 records the 13px/13px inset from a manual R-5 run only. Removing the compensation would make the button 6px wider; I did not run the suite to see whether that changes any row-count assertion.

potential_unspecified_behavior: Inline-size containment on the PDF viewer frame (PdfPreview.tsx:564) could change sizing if the frame is ever placed in a shrink-to-fit parent.
regression_risks: Changing ToolbarMenu's value-span class composition affects every ToolbarMenu caller. For callers that do not pass valueClassName, the output looked equivalent when I read the code.
test_coverage: pdf-toolbar-row-desktop.spec.ts covers the row count, whether the value is shown, a constant bar height across widths, and the aria-label. It does not cover where the icon sits inside the button.
